title: Brazil climate-finance awards (compiled)
description: Real awarded/selected climate-finance records in Brazil, indexed by reaching-money route (rollup) and per-record facets (funder, category, region, instrument). Manufactured by compiling public funder award/selection lists — not an ingested external dataset. Staging lane: not yet vetted through dataset-review. Sources are Portuguese-language primary documents. See collection.md for provenance and sources.yaml for the source registry. Sibling instance to dataset-compile/mn-climate-awards (Minnesota); same design, Brazilian values.
grain: one row per awarded/selected project (or per published award line, or a control-total aggregate row where only totals are public)

scope.in_scope: Routes A, B, C — narrow start (the 3 most award-rich routes, per knowledge-base/topics/climate-finance/br-climate-finance.md). Route A: the full Fundo Amazônia carteira (146 unique contracted/completed grants, reconciled to the Informe da Carteira 30/12/2025 control totals). Route C: the full COFIEX 180ª Reunião results table (32 line items, 22 project approvals, reconciled to the release's 18-subnacional / 4-federal / US$1.12bn-federal control totals). Route B: the FULL Novo PAC 2025 Prevenção a Desastres selected list (315 proposals across drenagem + contenção de encostas, FGTS + OGU), extracted from the 5 official Ministério das Cidades XLSX and reconciled to the eixo control totals (drenagem R$10.3bn, encostas >R$1.4bn, total R$11.7bn / 26 UFs), plus 3 eixo aggregate rows.
scope.not_yet_in_scope: Routes D (GCF/GEF/Adaptation Fund grant portfolios), E (MIDR/Sedec disaster transfers — S2ID/CPDC), F (emendas parlamentares — windfalls, no call). Fundo Clima (BNDES credit + MMA grant) project-level lists. FGTS/CAIXA saneamento & drenagem award-level data beyond the Novo PAC seleção (Transferegov). Additional COFIEX meetings beyond the 180ª. Per-project desembolso for Fundo Amazônia. Award dates for Fundo Amazônia (carteira gives situação, not contract date) and per-proposal dates for Novo PAC. Município-name normalization for Route B (230 distinct vs announced 235, due to inconsistent source spelling).
scope.complete_when: For each in-scope route, every published award/selection line is present with a source-read amount in native currency, every derived field is computed by a documented rule, and each route's row sums reconcile to a published control total.

field_provenance_legend.sourced: read directly from a primary source document (verifiable against source_url)
field_provenance_legend.derived: assigned by the compiler's judgment, NOT stated in the source — lower-trust until a deterministic rule is defined
field_provenance_legend.derived-by-rule: computed by an explicit, auditable rule/lookup (not per-row judgment); reproducible and correctable in one place

fields.name: route
fields.notes: Rollup index = the funding route from br-climate-finance.md. A=programmatic funds/credit lines (apply); B=public investment via federal transfers (formulate); C=direct external borrowing (COFIEX, CAPAG-gated). Derived from funder+instrument, not stated on the award page.

fields.name: funder
fields.notes: Administering programme/fund as named by the source (Fundo Amazônia; Novo PAC — Prevenção a Desastres; COFIEX — <MDB>).

fields.name: category
fields.notes: Assigned from programme + project name/theme by a keyword rule (raw/build_data.py). Needs a curated deterministic mapping before promotion. Adaptation-relevance is NOT assumed — climate-adaptation/urban-resilience are tagged only where the source names climate/adaptation/resilience.

fields.name: region_macro
fields.notes: Macrorregião computed from uf via references/br-region-lookup.csv. Multi-UF -> Interestadual; federal/nationwide -> Nacional; abroad -> Internacional. Not stated in the award source; reproducible via the lookup.

fields.name: uf
fields.notes: UF code(s) as given by the source (comma-separated for multi-state; BR for federal/nationwide; INTL for abroad).

fields.name: municipio
fields.notes: Município name where the recipient/proponent is a município (extracted from 'Município de X'); else blank.

fields.name: amazonia_legal
fields.notes: Whether the UF is in the Amazônia Legal, via references/br-region-lookup.csv (true if any UF for interestadual rows).

fields.name: instrument
fields.notes: From the programme's known instrument. Fundo Amazônia=grant (não-reembolsável); Novo PAC=grant+loan (OGU + FGTS financing); COFIEX=loan-external (MDB loan w/ Union guarantee).

fields.name: recipient
fields.notes: Responsável (Route A) / proponente (Route C) / município (Route B) as named by the source.

fields.name: recipient_type
fields.notes: From natureza (Route A) / esfera (Route C). Light judgment on edge cases; 'aggregate' = a control-total row, not a single recipient.

fields.name: amount
fields.notes: The award/loan/selection amount in NATIVE currency (see currency). Route A = valor do apoio (não-reembolsável). Route C = valor do empréstimo (EUR/JPY rows already converted to USD in the source). Route B project rows = the announced value; aggregate rows = the published eixo total.

fields.name: currency
fields.notes: Native currency of amount. No silent conversion. BRL for Fundo Amazônia & Novo PAC & COFIEX 'operações em reais'; USD for most COFIEX; EUR for the BRDE credit line.

fields.name: project_total
fields.notes: Route A only: valor do projeto (total cost incl. counterpart), in BRL. Blank elsewhere.

fields.name: financier
fields.notes: The operator/lender: BNDES (Route A); Ministério das Cidades OGU/FGTS (Route B); the MDB — BID/BIRD/CAF/AFD/NDB/FONPLATA (Route C).

fields.name: award_date
fields.notes: Route B=2025-09 (announcement); Route C=2025-06-18 (180ª reunião). Route A blank — the carteira publishes situação, not per-project contract date (a to-proper gap).

fields.name: status
fields.notes: Route A: contratado/concluido (carteira situação). Route B: selected / selected-aggregate. Route C: cofiex-approved (authorised to prepare, w/ Union guarantee) / cofiex-not-approved (submitted but rejected this meeting — the queue/gate, analogous to a nonfundable pipeline row).

fields.name: verified
fields.notes: true = read from a primary source AND reconciled to a published control total (Route A -> Informe 30/12/2025; Route C -> 180ª release totals; Route B aggregates + federal-release highlights). false = single local-press source, not cross-checked to the federal selected list (3 Route-B municipal rows).

fields.name: notes
fields.notes: Free text: esfera, caveats, conversion notes, reconciliation reference.

promotion_path: compile -> dataset-review (lock scope, replace derived route/category with deterministic rules, fill Route B per-município detail + award dates from primary sources, add Routes D/E, complete provenance) -> catalog + pipeline.
